comments.author: @oldbutbeautiful
comments.text: At 13:13, they talk about the horrors of the famine and how the starving citizens were made do absolutely pointless work, to justify their ‘wage’. But the image you show of a cliff faced mountain with a lush forest in the foreground, is Binevenagh which is in what is now called Northern Ireland and a long way from the rugged poor land of the West. - I can see this from my garden, and directly behind that mountain as the crow flies, is Scotland.
